configurations.name: Category order
configurations.source: Global template configuration coverages.categoryOrder; effective Sites may override. Shared across every category/product listing; featured_prod takes precedence. src/domain/coveragePresentation.ts

configurations.name: Product order
configurations.source: Established global template order from src/domain/coveragePresentation.ts and src/config/coverages/index.ts; preserved registered-product sequence, now explicit rather than inferred from display names. Effective-site productOrder overrides this list within categories; featured_prod takes precedence. Unlisted products retain their incoming order.
